subtitle: Website Stability & Experience Refinement
changes: Reduced redundant website navigation work by coalescing repeated sidebar class changes and mobile-search updates into one animation-frame refresh.
Stopped rewriting identical recent-tool shortcuts and removed a duplicate recent-visit update when navigating through the website hero or quick-access actions.
Improved My Quick Deck stability by reusing existing checkbox elements instead of destroying and recreating the editor on every favorite change, preserving keyboard focus and scroll position.
Made page-context breadcrumbs update only when the active studio actually changes, without changing any studio navigation or player data.
Added progressive offscreen painting to common long-list entries where supported, plus isolated layout containment for homepage cards; unsupported browsers retain normal rendering.
Preserved all v4.8 startup optimizations, four bundled site resources, Battle.net authentication, the Cloudflare Worker, Sovereign Data Vault, existing studios, and saved user records.
Added source and Chromium/WebKit browser regression tests for Quick Deck node identity, repeated navigation, 240-row list interactions, responsive overflow and continued v4.8 startup behavior.
